advisory.summary: missing authentication: the experimental REST API exposes an unauthenticated get_code sink that reads arbitrary DAG source off disk; the experimental API has no access control by default and was removed wholesale in Airflow 3.0.0

acquisition.notes: Fixed variant applying the real upstream fix (PR #41434, 'Delete experimental API', Airflow 3.0.0): endpoints.py and get_code.py are deleted wholesale and the init_api_experimental blueprint registration is removed. Only the stable-API wiring remains -- no @api_experimental.route ingress and no get_code sink anywhere in the tree.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The fix deletes the experimental API outright: the get_code sink no longer resolves (symbol removal) and the route decorator plus blueprint registration are gone (path removal), so no ingress-to-sink path exists -- reachable_candidate flips to not_exploitable. Reasoned rather than proven because non-exploitability proof requires the two-trace. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
